references.text: Jesus tells the disciples that whoever wants to follow him must deny themselves, take up their cross and follow him.
Jesus urges his listeners to deny themselves, take up their cross daily and follow him.
Jesus calls the crowd and the disciples to himself and says that whoever wants to follow him must deny themselves, take up their cross and follow him.
John writes about the test of love, which involves laying down one's life for the brothers, something that can be seen as a parallel to bearing one's cross.
